name: cloudflare-d1
description: Cloudflare's native serverless SQLite edge database with read replication, batch transactions, and Drizzle ORM support.
author: Awesome API Skills Team
pitfalls: Using string interpolation in env.DB.prepare() instead of parameterized .bind() calls (opening SQL injection vulnerabilities)
Attempting interactive BEGIN TRANSACTION / COMMIT SQL statements instead of using env.DB.batch([...])
Forgetting to bind d1_databases in wrangler.toml / wrangler.jsonc
checklist: All user inputs bound via env.DB.prepare(sql).bind(...params)
Multi-statement atomic transactions executed via env.DB.batch([...])
